subject: integration
name: Bitcoin standard (BTC_0_1)
summary: Defines Bitcoin addresses, building a payment from coins a site lists, and signing payments and messages with the person's own keys, each time they confirm; two swap-refund groups are the browser's own. It names a decoder compiled into the app that only turns the bytes to sign into the confirmation text. The row holds no key and opens no connection. Nothing here checks that a Crypto behaves as the definition says; the Crypto that answers is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a definition plus a local decoder. Judged here by its publisher.
